reason: 140 frontend nodes are already prepared. These additional local trees overlap capabilities already owned by existing nodes; integrating them now would create duplicate runtimes/state/interaction paths.

verified_local_trees.why: Dialog/menu/popover/focus patterns overlap command palette, shell focus/inert and context-menu accessibility nodes. Factory core is vanilla JS; do not introduce a parallel React control runtime for this gap.
Accessible control patterns are useful, but current QA already tests keyboard/focus/touch targets and adding React runtime would be disproportionate.
Touch arbitration, drag intent, layer reorder and multiselect already have dedicated owner nodes. Do not create a second drag engine.
Page-editor capability overlaps existing Craft.js/Frappe patterns and canonical editor state. No second page-builder engine.
GSAP already has an OSS adapter node and reduced-motion has an explicit frontend improvement node.
A data-grid component could be useful later but is not a current Factory closure gap and would expand product scope.
Chart.js already owns the bounded chart adapter task. Add ECharts only if Chart.js cannot meet a demonstrated requirement.
Gantt is a useful future component but not required by current five-step Factory closure.

activation_contract: If an existing node produces GAP_RESOLVABLE and one of these donors directly matches that gap: READ_FRESH -> verify local code/license -> create a new F-FE-210+ node with unique write_scope -> thin pattern/adapter only -> focused microtest -> browser test -> PASS_RELEASED -> SEG-11 integration. Otherwise no task is created.
